name: com.adona-robot/market-data
title: Adona Robot market data
description: Forex and gold data API: real-time XAUUSD and FX, 1s candles, redistribution allowed, from CHF 500.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by your Adona Robot API key. Only get_candles needs it, billed like GET /v1/candles.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Your Adona Robot API key, for a client or gateway that keeps Authorization for itself. Only get_candles needs it; two different keys in the two headers are refused.
